title: TEHRAN, November 3rd - Iran's FM Spox, Esmaeil Baqaei made remarks in an interview on the sidelines of the national conference “The Call of Awakening: From Iran to Palestine,”
text:
TEHRAN, November 3rd - Iran's FM Spox, Esmaeil Baqaei made remarks in an interview on the sidelines of the national conference “The Call of Awakening: From Iran to Palestine,” "

"-----"

"SOT1, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran's FM Spox (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:45): "Iran utilizes diplomacy and the field as tools for its own defense. Under these circumstances, dialogue and negotiation should be viewed from this perspective. Ultimately, we can neither forget nor ignore the past or the events that have occurred over these two years; however, we have always stated that we have no fear of diplomacy. The point is that our logic is clear, our reasoning is clear, and we know we are in the right. From this angle, we use the tools of diplomacy and dialogue to secure the interests of the Iranian people and, simultaneously, to prevent the escalation of insecurity in the region.”"

""
"SOT2, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran's FM Spox (Farsi) (00:46 - 01:37): "Everyone knows that the United States has repeatedly undermined diplomacy and attacked diplomatic processes. We do not need to go far back into the past; look at the events that have occurred within this past year. In less than one year, on two separate occasions while we were in the middle of negotiations, they attacked Iran; subsequently, when the Islamabad understanding was reached, less than two or three weeks later, the U.S. [acted differently]. With full knowledge of this experience, and to speak without reservation and with the utmost caution, we participated in every diplomatic process with complete skepticism.”"

""
"SOT3, Esmaeil Baqaei, Iran's FM Spox (Farsi) (01:38 - 02:33): "Our demands are clear. As long as our demands are completely legitimate and logical, we cannot talk about the content of Iran’s demands. Well, can we imagine an agreement being reached without a commitment to halting the war on all fronts, including in Lebanon? What was agreed upon in the Islamabad understanding and unfortunately violated by the Americans,in clause one of the understanding, the issue of halting the war on all fronts, including Lebanon, this is one of the key issues of any diplomatic process.”
